scientific_limitations: The complete modal count is for positive strict-speed/strict-tumbling parameters and steepness relation g=4u. A three-peak witness persists in a full-dimensional open neighborhood with independently varying g and u. No unrestricted maximum count or nonequilibrium noise extension is proved. Prior general stationary-density formulas are established results, not newly claimed.
title: Three-mode stationary phases in a run-and-tumble particle with saturating rates
